calls.reason: The forecast of collapse has no deadline. The only evidence is OpenAI's October 2026 ServiceNow announcement, which shows the company still operating and says nothing about failure or unpaid counterparties.

CNBC reports OpenAI recently reached a $40B run rate and Anthropic hit $47B in May and $65B at the end of July. Quartz/Bloomberg give the end-2025 baseline of about $20B, which fits the seven-month framing.
The November 18 deadline hasn't passed. Reuters reports a roughly $30B raise partly driven by strategy, and PYMNTS said Q1 burn implied no near-term need, so no actual funding shortfall is shown.
PYMNTS confirms only $5.7B of Q1 revenue and $3.7B of cash burn. No readable source shows that the $12.1B was all compute or that it excluded data and salary costs.
